mcq.question: How does extending the payment period affect the present value of a uniform series of $ 4,000 per year at an interest rate of 6%?

options.A: The present value decreases as the payment period is extended.
options.B: The present value remains the same regardless of the payment period.
options.C: The present value increases as the payment period is extended.
options.D: The present value is unaffected by changes in the interest rate.

mcq.explanation: Extending the payment period decreases the present value because future payments are discounted over more periods, reducing their present worth.
